purpose: Pin one publication-backed, machine-readable stellar-variability label source before any Phase 3 crossmatch or representation training

catalog.name: Catalina Surveys periodic variable star catalog
catalog.ground_truth_basis: Publication-backed classifications derived from the catalog light curves, with inspection flags and comparison against prior surveys; suitable as source labels subject to a future mission-footprint crossmatch and leakage audit.
known_label_limitations: The publication reports a few-percent ambiguity between RRc and contact-binary classifications.

Catalog class codes include eclipsing-binary subclasses as well as intrinsic stellar variables; the future benchmark must preserve class identity rather than collapse every row into one undifferentiated label.
Sky-coordinate matching alone is not authorization to use a row; the future crossmatch must define angular, magnitude, duplicate, and target-group safeguards.

rejected_alternatives.reason: model_outputs_not_ground_truth: best_class_name is automated classifier output rather than a human or publication-review verdict; retain only as possible auxiliary metadata
gated_and_storage_exceeds_limit: the Hugging Face dataset requires access approval and is approximately 160 GB, exceeding the 100 GB pre-go-live project ceiling

next_gate.task: Design and verify a bounded coordinate/identity crossmatch against the 2790-TIC cached TESS representation inventory
next_gate.parallel_shape: Use the single-parent six-shard/six-worker pattern for independent TIC metadata resolution after a small live-service throughput measurement.
next_gate.storage_policy: Remain metadata-only until expected overlap and payload size are measured; the full Catalina gzip itself is only 1166660 bytes but is not downloaded by this contract gate.

limitations: This contract verifies source identity, schema, counts, and bounded delivery metadata only.
It does not download the full catalog, resolve TIC coordinates, perform a spatial crossmatch, open light curves, extract embeddings, train a model, or change production scoring.
Crossmatch and training remain unauthorized until separate leakage-safe design and evidence gates pass.
